summary.text: If you are eligible for subsidised vaccination, MediSave may cover the out-of-pocket expense. Check your clinic first.

steps.name: Check the clinic
steps.text: Ask your preferred CHAS GP clinic or polyclinic if it can process the remaining co-payment through MediSave.

steps.name: Check your eligibility
steps.text: If the clinic can do this, ask the clinic whether you are eligible to pay through MediSave.

example_phrasings: Can MediSave be used for the co-payment after subsidy for vaccinations?
Can MediSave pay the vaccination co-payment?
Can I use MediSave after the vaccination subsidy?

sources.page_title: Can MediSave be used for the co-payment after subsidy for vaccinations?

quotes.text: Those eligible for subsidised vaccination may also use their MediSave to cover the out-of-pocket expense at CHAS GP clinics and polyclinics.
Please check with your preferred clinic if the clinic is able to process the remaining co-payment via MediSave.
If they do, please check with them on your eligibility to pay via MediSave.
